labels.name: documentation
labels.rationale: Names a specific docs error: CONTRIBUTING.md links to the master-branch AI_POLICY.md, which 404s on this repo's main branch.

items.body:
The broken link is in `CONTRIBUTING.md` line 14, which points to `https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/AI_POLICY.md`. The repository's default branch is `main`, so that link returns a 404. The fix belongs in `CONTRIBUTING.md`, and it is a docs change rather than a code change.

Pull requests are currently limited to repository collaborators, so a change like this goes through an issue first, as described in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md). This issue already describes the change, so no further step is needed from you here. Related: #4203 covers when pull requests will be accepted from external contributors.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
